say:3:1311112001:1.text: Wow! That was dangerous! If it weren't for Chippy's quick moves, Chippy would've gotten hit! This tree trunk is all rotted out! No wonder it fell so suddenly...
say:3:1311112001:1.source_cn: 哎呀！要不是满满躲得快，就会被砸到脑袋了！这棵树的树干...

say:4:1311112002:1.text: You guys hear that? What kind of animals are making those strange noises? It's so strange...
say:4:1311112002:1.source_cn: 你们听，那是什么动物？叫声好奇怪啊！

say:5:1311112003:1.text: Those are no ordinary creatures; they're hawk moths, native to this forest. They are aggressive toward outsiders who dare to invade their territory.
say:5:1311112003:1.source_cn: 那不是什么动物，是黑沼森林里的一种名叫鹰蛾的怪物，对入...

say:6:1311112004:1.text: *Gasp* Is Ludovic really living in this scary place?
say:6:1311112004:1.source_cn: 啊，原来黑沼森林里这么危险！柳博米尔就住在这种荒凉又可...

say:7:1311112005:1.text: Don't worry about him, hawk moths rarely attack the Graveborn.
say:7:1311112005:1.source_cn: 不必为他担心，鹰蛾很少会攻击亡灵。

say:9:1311112007:1.text: Even the trees here look all twisted and scary... I think we should get out of here quickly.
say:9:1311112007:1.source_cn: 这里的氛围怪怪的，连树都长得很狰狞……我觉得我们还是早...

choice_prompt:10:1311112007.text: Even the trees here look all twisted and scary... I think we should get out of here quickly.
choice_prompt:10:1311112007.source_cn: 这里的氛围怪怪的，连树都长得很狰狞……我觉得我们还是早点离开这里比较好。

say:11:1311112008:1.text: Alright, here comes Sir Chippy! Stand back while Chippy chops through this tree in a flash!
say:11:1311112008:1.source_cn: 没错，区区一棵枯树，满满就可以把它劈开！

say:12:1311112010:1.text: Let Chippy give this tree a little taste of his sword!
